correctness.rationale: Integrating each bridge covariance section gives k(t)=t(1-t)/2 and Var(J)=1/12. Gaussian elimination gives the gain from the positive-definite noisy Gram matrix, even at repeated sites. I independently reproduced its offset derivative: at fixed gap the sign on the positive offset half depends only on a factor strictly increasing with squared offset. Thus any off-center interior critical point is a minimum, never a maximum, and reflection reduces the candidates to the center or domain endpoints in offset. The latter have at most one informative reading and are strictly dominated by two midpoint readings. The centered derivative has one simple root of 3d^2-(4+8 eta)d+1 in (0,1/3), with the gain rising before and falling after it. Its stationarity equation gives the exact risk, strict noise monotonicity and high-noise scale, with positive gap at every finite positive variance. This proves uniqueness up to exchange of the readings.
residual_risks: No claim for correlated noise, more readings or path IMSE. The supplied rational comparisons are not used to prove the continuum maximum.
